title: Min Stack (Functional)
statement: Given a list of stack operations, replay them against a stack that supports push, pop, top, and getMin, and return the list of results produced by the query operations ("top" and "getMin"), in order. Operations are given as ["push", value], ["pop"], ["top"], or ["getMin"]. Every "pop", "top", and "getMin" is guaranteed to be issued only while the stack is non-empty.
hints: Store each element alongside the minimum seen so far at that stack depth.
Pushing a new value: the new running minimum is min(value, previous minimum).
getMin and top just read from the top of the stack; pop discards it.
